entity.summary: Gibraltar-origin centralized digital asset exchange launched in July 2018 as the GBX-DAX. GSX Group sold GBX to Australian exchange Mine Digital in January 2021; the GBX-DAX closed on 2021-01-29 and customer assets and accounts were transferred into the Mine Digital transition process.
entity.notes: The GBX-DAX launched in July 2018; HEI normalizes the month-level launch to 2018-07-01 because the reviewed sources do not establish an exact launch day. GBX later moved its operating company from Gibraltar to Estonia, but this record keeps Gibraltar as the historical origin of the exchange identity. On 2021-01-29 GSX Group completed the sale of GBX to Mine Digital and simultaneously closed the GBX-DAX; Mine Digital did not continue the GBX brand or platform technology. HEI therefore classifies the terminal state as acquired with acquisition as the death reason rather than a bankruptcy or failure. Mine Digital is not linked by successor_id because no reviewed Mine Digital canonical entity is currently resolved in HEI. The original gbx.global domain remains reachable but now mixes archived GBX material with unrelated post-closure editorial/affiliate content, so it is classified as repurposed and should not be treated as a current exchange service endpoint.

events.title: GBX-DAX launched as the Global Blockchain Exchange digital asset market
events.description: GSX Group launched the GBX-DAX digital asset exchange in July 2018 as the secondary-market component of the Global Blockchain Exchange ecosystem.
events.notes: Month-level launch marker normalized to the first day of July because the reviewed first-party source states the launch month but not an exact day.

events.title: Mine Digital acquired GBX from GSX Group
events.description: GSX Group completed the sale of Global Blockchain Exchange to Australian digital asset exchange Mine Digital as part of a strategic repositioning away from the GBX exchange business.
events.notes: The 2021-01-13 first-party sale announcement established the planned acquisition and the 2021-01-29 first-party completion notice confirmed that the sale had completed.

events.title: GBX-DAX closed after the Mine Digital sale
events.description: The GBX-DAX closed on 2021-01-29, withdrawals were halted, customer accounts were closed, and remaining customer assets were transferred into the Mine Digital account-transition process.
events.notes: Mine Digital did not continue operations under the GBX banner or use the GBX platform technology, so HEI treats this as the effective end of the independent GBX exchange identity. The event-linked first-party FAQ documents the closure; the acquisition completion notice separately corroborates the same-day shutdown in the wider record.

evidence.title: The Gibraltar Blockchain Exchange is now licensed by the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission
evidence.notes: First-party GSX Group publication states that the GBX-DAX Digital Asset Exchange launched in July 2018.

evidence.title: Gibraltar Blockchain Exchange Awarded Licence by Gibraltar Financial Services Commission
evidence.notes: Government press release identifies Gibraltar Blockchain Exchange as a token-sale platform and Digital Asset Exchange subsidiary of the Gibraltar Stock Exchange and records its Gibraltar DLT licence.

evidence.title: Global Blockchain Exchange (GBX) - Sale to Mine Digital
evidence.notes: First-party sale announcement states that GSX Group was selling GBX to Mine Digital, that Mine Digital would not continue the GBX banner or platform technology, and provides the planned trading and closure timetable.

evidence.title: Global Blockchain Exchange (GBX) Completes Sale Process to Mine Digital
evidence.notes: First-party completion notice confirms that GSX Group sold GBX to Mine Digital on 2021-01-29 and also states that the GBX-DAX closed that day.

evidence.title: GBX sale and closure FAQs
evidence.notes: First-party FAQ states that trading ceased on 2021-01-20 and that the GBX-DAX closed, withdrawals stopped, and customer accounts closed on 2021-01-29, with remaining assets transferred to Mine Digital.

evidence.title: Current gbx.global homepage
evidence.notes: The original domain remains reachable and preserves historical GBX sale material, but it also contains unrelated post-closure editorial and affiliate content. HEI therefore treats the historical domain as repurposed rather than as a live exchange endpoint.
